_comment: Button index -> plain-text meaning. Copy to buttons.json and edit freely: the listener re-reads this on every event, so no restart is needed. null = unassigned (a press still makes a record). "IGNORE" = the press is dropped and nothing is sent (use it for a test button). Button 9 (sync) is a hardware reset and never posts.
4: a feed took place (details to come later)
8: a pump happened — volume unknown until details come later
